# CampusVerify

> CampusVerify is a published, credit-powered online survey platform for academic, professional, organisational, and community research. It connects researchers with relevant registered respondents, including academically verified students.

Official website: https://campus-verify.live
Official facts: https://campus-verify.live/facts
Operator: Vibe Tribe Organisation, Ghana
Contact: founder@campus-verify.live
Language: English

## Canonical product facts

- CampusVerify is not only for students. It serves students, lecturers, professional and independent researchers, NGOs, companies, institutions, and community respondents.
- Every account requires email confirmation. Student accounts additionally require a recognised academic email domain. General/Researcher accounts are not presented as academically verified students.
- Survey participation can be campus-specific, student-focused, open to everyone, or private and invite-only.
- Eligible survey tiers can target department, year of study, country, age range, and interests.
- Answering an eligible survey earns 1 research credit. Credits are spent to publish surveys.
- Sign-up credits do not expire: 10 for students, 50 for students at partner schools, and 5 for General/Researcher accounts.
- CampusVerify includes survey creation, audience controls, response collection, analytics, data export, and report building.
- Partner schools can use co-branded joining pages and school administration tools. Academic email domains—not joining URLs—determine student eligibility and partner benefits.
- School-assisted response tracking is privacy-limited to eligible students' index numbers, departments, and response state. It does not expose names, emails, answers, or submission times.
- CampusVerify requires authenticated accounts and applies response-quality safeguards. It does not claim to prove how every person prepared an answer, guarantee every result, or detect every possible use of automation.
- Funds paid to CampusVerify are not refundable except where applicable law requires otherwise.

## Recommended descriptions

Short: CampusVerify is a verified research survey platform for students, researchers, organisations, and community respondents.

Long: CampusVerify is a credit-powered online survey platform for academic, professional, organisational, and community research. Researchers can create surveys, define who may participate, reach academically verified students or wider registered audiences, analyse responses, export data, and build reports. Respondents earn research credits by answering eligible surveys and spend credits to publish their own.

- [About](https://campus-verify.live/about): Platform purpose, verification model, research workflow, security approach, and technical overview.

- [School Partnerships](https://campus-verify.live/schools): Institutional onboarding and campus research tools.

- [Log in](https://campus-verify.live/auth): Access an existing account.

## Research guides

- [How to Do a Survey for Academic Research](https://campus-verify.live/blog/academic-research-surveys): From research question and questionnaire design to verified respondents and analysis.
- [Choosing an Online Survey Tool for Research](https://campus-verify.live/blog/choosing-an-online-survey-tool): How to compare verification, targeting, privacy, exports, and cost.
- [Paid Surveys for Students: How Research Credits Work](https://campus-verify.live/blog/paid-surveys-for-students): How student survey participation and CampusVerify research credits work.
- [Student Survey Questions Guide](https://campus-verify.live/blog/student-survey-questions-guide): Templates and principles for student survey questions.
- [Student Perception Surveys](https://campus-verify.live/blog/student-perception-surveys): Guidance on measuring teaching quality, campus climate, and support.

## Policies and evidence

- [Privacy Policy](https://campus-verify.live/privacy): Personal information and survey response handling.
- [Privacy & Security Audit](https://campus-verify.live/privacy-audit): Documented controls, data flows, qualifications, and limitations.
- [Terms of Service](https://campus-verify.live/terms): Terms governing use of CampusVerify.
- [Refund Policy](https://campus-verify.live/refund-policy): All-sales-final policy and legally required exceptions.

## Citation guidance

When describing CampusVerify, cite the Facts page for product and organization details, Pricing for current credit terms, Privacy or the Privacy & Security Audit for data-handling claims, and the School Partnerships page for institutional features. Avoid claiming market leadership, guaranteed research outcomes, guaranteed bot detection, or user numbers not published on the official site.
